title: Eco-Bot Builders - Serialized Block Program
description: A student's visual block program as serialized by the Unity BlockParserEngine and stored in LevelTelemetry.blockProgramSnapshot. The root is an ordered array of top-level blocks; nested blocks (loop bodies, if/else branches) live in 'children'. Note: children reference '#/definitions/block' (not the root '#'), because the root is an array and each child must be a single block object. The backend rejects snapshots with more than 500 top-level blocks.

x-parameter-semantics.TRIGGER_ALWAYS_LOOP: null - runs children forever (until the level ends or the class is paused).
x-parameter-semantics.INPUT_MOISTURE_SENSOR: number 0-1 threshold, used as the condition input of CONDITION_IF.
x-parameter-semantics.INPUT_BATTERY_CHARGE: number 0-1 threshold, used as the condition input of CONDITION_IF.
x-parameter-semantics.CONDITION_IF: string expression or null; the first child may be an INPUT_* block providing the condition.
x-parameter-semantics.CONDITION_ELSE: null - must directly follow a CONDITION_IF sibling.
x-parameter-semantics.SUBROUTINE_CALL: string subroutine name; children hold the subroutine body at its definition site.
x-parameter-semantics.ACTION_MOVE: number of tiles to move forward (default 1).
x-parameter-semantics.ACTION_WATER: number of water units (default 1) or null.
x-parameter-semantics.ACTION_ROTATE_TURBINE: number of degrees (multiples of 90) or null for a single 90-degree step.

uiPosition.description: Editor canvas placement in Unity UI units (RectTransform anchoredPosition and size).

blockId.description: Unique id of the block within the program.
